title: Misr Beni Suef Cement’s net profit increases in first nine months of 2026
summary: Misr Beni Suef Cement’s net profit increases in first nine months of 2026
body_markdown: **Egypt:** Misr Beni Suef Cement reported a 2% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit during the first nine months of 2026, according to the financial statement filed to the Egyptian Exchange on 11 November 2026. Net profit was US$39.3m in the nine-month period ending 30 September 2026 compared to US$38.5m in the corresponding period of 2025. Sales amounted to US$88.5m, growing by 16.6% year-on-year from US$75.9m in the same period of 2025.
